read_dduf_file: read a DDUF file and return a dictionary of entries with filename, offset, and length metadata
export_entries_as_dduf: export an iterable of filename-content entries into an uncompressed DDUF archive file
export_folder_as_dduf: export a local folder of diffusion model files into a DDUF archive
DDUFEntry_as_mmap: open a DDUF file entry as a memory-mapped file for loading safetensors directly
DDUFEntry_read_text: read a DDUF file entry as decoded text for JSON or TXT entries
